# <!--name-->Run Lychee Link Check<!--/name-->

<!--description-->
Run Lychee with the shared repository config installed from npm dependencies.
<!--/description-->

## Inputs

<!--inputs-->
| Name                | Description                                                   | Required | Default                                                        |
|---------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|----------|----------------------------------------------------------------|
| `args`              | Arguments passed to lycheeverse/lychee-action.                | `false`  | `--config node_modules/lychee-config-nick2bad4u/lychee.toml .` |
| `config-path`       | Expected Lychee config path.                                  | `false`  | `node_modules/lychee-config-nick2bad4u/lychee.toml`            |
| `fail`              | Fail the workflow when Lychee finds broken links.             | `false`  | `true`                                                         |
| `fail-if-empty`     | Fail the workflow when Lychee finds no links to check.        | `false`  | `false`                                                        |
| `lychee-version`    | Lychee binary version installed by lycheeverse/lychee-action. | `false`  | `v0.24.2`                                                      |
| `working-directory` | Directory where Lychee runs.                                  | `false`  | `.`                                                            |
